questions.question_text_th: Situation 8: Rectangle area 200 sq m. Length is 2 times width. Find both.
questions.explanation: width=x, length=2x | x x 2x=200 -> 2x^2=200 -> x^2=100 -> x=10 | length=20

questions.question_text_th: Situation 9: Rectangle area 168 sq m, perimeter 52 m. Find width and length.
questions.hint_th: 2(x+y)=52 -> x+y=26. xy=168. Numbers that multiply to 168 and add to 26: 12 and 14.

questions.question_text: Situation 10: Parallelogram base 20 m, height 12 m. Rectangle 15 m by 15 m. Which area is larger?
questions.question_text_th: Situation 10: Parallelogram base 20 m, height 12 m. Rectangle 15 m by 15 m. Which area is larger?
choices: Parallelogram 240 sq m > Rectangle 225 sq m
questions.correct_answer: Parallelogram 240 sq m > Rectangle 225 sq m
questions.answer: Parallelogram 240 sq m > Rectangle 225 sq m
questions.explanation: Parallelogram = 20x12=240 sq m. Rectangle = 15x15=225 sq m. Parallelogram is larger.
questions.explanation_th: Parallelogram = 20x12=240 sq m. Rectangle = 15x15=225 sq m. Parallelogram is larger.
questions.hint_th: Parallelogram area = base x height. Rectangle = width x length.
